_comment: Every environment, and the facts about it that are not secret.
Two worlds, the same shape, so production is a parameter rather than a
rewrite: `deploy/provision-aws.sh production` builds the second one from
this file, with names that cannot collide with the first.
The OTA channel is the link between a git branch and a binary. The
development branch publishes to the development channel, which TestFlight
and Play-internal builds carry; main publishes to production, which App
Store and Play-production builds carry. Neither can reach the other, so a
bad staging bundle cannot land on a shop's phone.
Secrets live in deploy/env/<environment>.env, on the box and nowhere else.
